query: how to push knowledge chunk to Qdrant
normalized_query: how to push knowledge chunk to Qdrant
answer: [UNVERIFIED] To push a knowledge chunk to Qdrant, use the `push-to-qdrant.sh` script, which reads the merged output from `~/scripts/YYYY-MM-DD-[slug].md`, splits it on regex `^##[space]CHUNK` to isolate each chunk, extracts per-chunk metadata from comment markers using Ollama, and upserts to Qdrant via n8n webhook using the URL and API-key stored in `~/.rag_config.json`.
